in_arabic.name: Areeq
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني The Small One
in_arabic.long_meaning: Areeq هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'arak', meaning 'small' or 'little'. In Islamic tradition, this name is given to a child as a reminder of their small stature and dependence on Allah.
